headline: Customs Orders Firearms Inventory as Zamboanga Observes Day of Mourning
seoTitle: Customs Firearms Inventory Ordered After Zamboanga Shooting | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News package reports a nationwide Bureau of Customs firearms inventory as Zamboanga City declared August 19 a day of mourning after the school shooting.
deck: The response combines an internal government weapon review with a city-wide period of mourning after the fatal campus attack.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News overnight package reports that Bureau of Customs Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno ordered an inventory of government-issued firearms following the finding that a service weapon was connected to the Ateneo de Zamboanga shooting investigation.
The same package reports that Zamboanga City declared Wednesday, August 19, a formal Day of Mourning.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The firearms review follows scrutiny of how a minor gained access to a government-issued weapon. The chain of custody remains an investigative question unless established by authorities.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: A firearms inventory can identify accountability gaps in issuance and safekeeping, while the mourning declaration recognizes the community impact of the shooting.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the Bureau of Customs for inventory findings and corrective measures, and local authorities for memorial, school-support and investigation updates.
